words.e: I open
words.m: ἀνά (up, L10) + the sound "an-OY-go" — a door creaking *open*: "oy!" and you go through

words.e: I will become (deponent fut. of γίνομαι)
words.m: γίνομαι (L9) → "genesis," the *becoming*; the future adds -σ- before the ending: γεν-ήσ-ομαι (deponent: middle form, active meaning, L9)

words.e: I will know (deponent fut. of γινώσκω)
words.m: γινώσκω (L2) → "agnostic"/"gnostic" (knowing); root γνω- + σ + -ομαι = *I will know*

words.e: I will teach
words.m: διδάσκω (L2, "didactic"); the σκ + σ blend into ξ ("x"): διδάσκ-σω → διδάξω

words.e: teacher
words.m: from διδάσκω (L2, I teach): the one who does the *teaching*; "didactic"

words.e: I glorify
words.m: δόξα (glory, L3) + the verb ending -ζω: "doxology" — to give *glory*

words.e: I will be able (deponent fut. of δύναμαι)
words.m: δύναμαι (L9, "dynamite"): the stem vowel lengthens α → η (as in γεν-ήσ-ομαι), then σ + -ομαι: δυν-ήσ-ομαι; deponent (L9) = middle form, active meaning

words.e: if, whether (usually followed by an indicative mood verb)
words.m: sounds like "ay" — "ay, *if* you say so"; don't confuse with εἰς (into, L6) or εἰμί (I am, L7)

words.e: I will come (deponent fut. of ἔρχομαι)
words.m: sounds like "el-YOU-so-my" — "*you*, so-and-so, I *will come*!"; different stem from ἔρχομαι (L9), so learn the pair; deponent (L9)

words.e: I will have (fut. of ἔχω; note the rough breathing)
words.m: ἔχω (L3, "echo"): the χ + σ blend into ξ (as σκ + σ did in διδάξω), and the breathing changes from smooth to rough; "I'll *have* a *hex* on you"

words.e: I will be (fut. of εἰμί)
words.m: εἰμί (L7, "hey, me!") → "ESS-oh-my" — "*I will be*, oh my!"; future stem ἐσ- + middle endings (-ομαι, -ῃ, -εται…)

words.e: I will find (fut. of εὑρίσκω)
words.m: εὑρίσκω (L8, "Eureka!"): the stem εὑρ- + η + σω = εὑρ-ή-σω; an *active* ending (-σω), so not deponent

words.e: I marvel, wonder (thaumaturge)
words.m: "thaumaturge" — a *wonder*-worker, one who makes people *marvel*

vf.e: I was marveling / they were marveling

words.e: I will marvel, wonder (deponent middle fut. of θαυμάζω; also θαυμάσω)
words.m: θαυμάζω (L12, "thaumaturge"): the ζ drops and σ is added, as in δοξάζω → δοξάσω; this is the deponent middle future. θαυμάσω (L12) is the regular active future with the same meaning: both are correct

words.e: I will marvel, wonder (active fut. of θαυμάζω; also θαυμάσομαι)
words.m: θαυμάζω (L12, "thaumaturge"): the ζ drops and σ is added, as in δοξάζω → δοξάσω; this is the regular active future. θαυμάσομαι (L12) is the deponent middle future with the same meaning: both are correct

words.e: I preach, proclaim
words.m: "kerygma" — the *proclamation* of the gospel

words.e: I will take, receive (deponent fut. of λαμβάνω)
words.m: λαμβάνω (L5, "lamb, I take you"): α → η, and β + σ blend into ψ ("ps"): λήμψομαι; deponent (L9)

words.e: now
words.m: looks and sounds like English *now* (Latin *nunc*) — n…n, *now*

words.e: I will bring, bear, carry (fut. of φέρω)
words.m: φέρω (L12, "Christopher"): a completely different stem, οἰ-; "*Oy*, so I'll *bring* it"; learn it as a pair with φέρω, like ἔρχομαι / ἐλεύσομαι (L9)

words.e: I pray
words.m: πρός (toward, L6) + εὔχομαι (to wish, vow): turning *toward* God with a wish = *pray*; deponent (L9)

words.e: I will eat (deponent fut. of ἐσθίω; also ἔδομαι in the LXX)
words.m: ἐσθίω (L7, "esophagus"): a different stem, φαγ-; "sarcophagus" (flesh-*eater*), "-phage" = *eating*; deponent (L9)

words.e: I bring, bear, carry (Christopher, pheresis)
words.m: "Christopher" = *Christ-bearer*; "pheresis" (as in apheresis) = a *carrying* off; the Latin cousin -fer in "conifer" (cone-*bearing*)
